aarti.tek: Hari Om. Perform the āratī of Śrī Śākambharī Ambā. Hold so wondrous a form in your heart. Perform the āratī of compassionate Śatākṣī.
aarti.pad1: You are the all-complete, primal Bhavānī, Mother. You are in every heart, Mother; you yourself are described so. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: You alone are Śākambharī; you alone are Śatākṣī, Mother. You are of auspicious form, and Māyā; you alone are the light-giver, Mother. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: O Mother Ambā, whoever, man or woman, sings your āratī every day, fulfil their wishes; they gain the sight of Śākambharī, Mother. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: Whoever reads the āratī and has others read it, Mother, whoever hears the āratī and recites it to others, Mother, dwells in Vaikuṇṭha and gains the sight of Śākambharī. ॥4॥
